mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.type AS type, s.name AS name, ST_Latitude(s.location) AS lat, ST_Longitude(s.location) AS lng, s.address AS address, s.park_warning AS park_warning, pa.name AS area_name, pa.source AS area_source, pa.source_date AS area_source_date, b.description AS description, b.has_water AS has_water, b.has_toilet AS has_toilet, b.signal_level AS signal_level, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bakji_confirmation c WHERE c.spot_id = s.id) AS confirmation_count, b.reporter_id AS reporter_id, m.nickname AS reporter_nickname, d.source AS source, d.category AS category, d.facilities AS facilities, d.phone AS phone, d.homepage AS homepage, d.source_date AS source_date, d.operating_status AS operating_status, d.closed_from AS closed_from, d.closed_until AS closed_until, (SELECT MAX(r.finished_at) FROM sync_job_run r WHERE r.job_type = d.source AND r.status = 'COMPLETED') AS checked_at FROM spot s LEFT JOIN public_spot_detail d ON d.spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN bakji_detail b ON b.spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN member m ON m.id = b.reporter_id LEFT JOIN protected_area pa ON pa.id = s.protected_area_id WHERE s.id = #{spotId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT ST_Latitude(s.location) AS lat, ST_Longitude(s.location) AS lng, s.weather_nx AS weather_nx, s.weather_ny AS weather_ny FROM spot s WHERE s.id = #{spotId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(per_member.review_count), 0) AS count, ROUND(AVG(per_member.member_average), 1) AS average FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(r.rating) AS member_average FROM spot_review r WHERE r.spot_id = #{spotId} GROUP BY r.member_id ) per_member

SELECT r.id AS review_id, r.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, r.visited_date AS visited_date, r.rating AS rating, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS created_at FROM spot_review r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id WHERE r.spot_id = #{spotId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id AS image_id, review_id, object_key FROM review_image WHERE review_id IN #{reviewId} ORDER BY review_id, display_order
mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basecamp_member m WHERE m.basecamp_id = b.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT b.start_date AS start_date, b.end_date AS end_date, AS headcount FROM basecamp b WHERE b.spot_id = #{spotId} AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND b.end_date > #{today}

SELECT t.start_date AS start_date, t.end_date AS end_date, 1 AS headcount FROM solo_trip t JOIN member m ON m.id = t.member_id WHERE t.spot_id = #{spotId} AND t.end_date > #{today} AND m.status <> 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT p.start_at AS start_at, p.end_at AS end_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM program_application a WHERE a.program_id = p.id AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED') AS headcount FROM program p WHERE p.spot_id = #{spotId} AND p.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND p.overnight = TRUE AND p.end_at > #{from}

SELECT b.id AS basecamp_id, b.title AS title, b.start_date AS start_date, b.end_date AS end_date, b.capacity AS capacity, AS headcount, b.min_trust_level AS min_trust_level, b.age_group_min AS age_group_min, b.age_group_max AS age_group_max, b.same_gender_only AS same_gender_only FROM basecamp b WHERE b.spot_id = #{spotId} AND b.status = 'RECRUITING' ORDER BY b.start_date, b.id
